title: Satoshi-era wallet served in a $260 billion lawsuit moves 75 BTC it held since 2011
summary: The roughly $5 million transfer also spent the tiny payment used to deliver a court notice to the address in May.

title: Bitcoin miners pay Paraguay $350 million a year, but AI is pushing them out
summary: Contracts that sell power to a 4% slice of the world’s bitcoin mining at $44 a megawatt-hour expire on Dec. 31, 2027. Paraguay’s state utility calls the date final, and it has just signed a 15-year deal to power a Founders Fund-backed AI campus.

title: Bitcoin plunges to $68,000 as Anthropic IPO frenzy adds to market jitters
summary: Analysts see no direct link between Nvidia and bitcoin's decline, pointing instead to investor capital headed into Anthropic as well as a broader risk-off move.

title: U.S. Senate Banking Committee races toward hearing on new SEC nominations
summary: The committee that needs to advance President Donald Trump's nominees responded quickly to set his SEC picks for review next week.

title: Bitcoin heads for sixth weekly loss as Anthropic’s blockbuster IPO looms
summary: Bitcoin is down 21% this year as investors weigh Anthropic’s anticipated listing, Nvidia’s leadership upheaval and rising Fed rate hike expectations.
